thread:
Aisha (AE): Heads up — Rivermoss signed the MSA. They want a POC next week using a custom 22B variant (sparse finetune) and need catalog onboarding + CCQ answers. Can we run a quick compatibility/gating check?
Marta (Solutions Eng): Nice — do we have the model artifact or HF repo link? Also need target latency and typical sequence lengths.
Aisha (AE): Link coming from customer (S3 presigned). They expect 95th p99 latency < 120ms for 2k context, mostly chat few-shot.
Connor (Infra): 22B + 2k context, p99 120ms is tight on shared hosts. What's the quant profile? fp16 / int8? KV cache behavior?
Aisha (AE): Customer says they used int8 with some custom fused ops. KV cache access pattern: frequent short-turn chats, average 8 tokens per turn.
Marta (Solutions Eng): Ok — three things we need to validate: tokenizer compatibility, KV cache/concat pattern (we can reuse prefix caching), and kernel support for their fused ops. If fused ops are custom, we need a shim or fallback.
Priya (Sales): Also list of deliverables for customer: POC runbook, time estimate, pricing (hosted vs dedicated), and CCQ RACI.
Marta (Solutions Eng): Quick checklist I can run: 1) Tokenizer exact match (ask for tokenizer.json) 2) Try a dry-run on our catalog validator 3) Run a variant compatibility scan for quant & opset 4) Perf estimate on xG-1/dedicated GPU.
Marta (Solutions Eng): If they can provide the tokenizer and a minimal inference tracing log we can often avoid code changes.
Aisha (AE): I'll ping their infra lead for tokenizer + a 2-min inference trace.
Connor (Infra): Operational constraints: for dedicated pricing baseline, assume a reserved 1 GPU pool (A100/80GB) for stable p99. Ballpark: $Xk/mo for reserved capacity + setup. For hosted trial, we can do burst but latency not SLA-backed.
SecurityBot: CCQ flags to prepare for: KMS key ownership, VPC peering or PrivateLink, retention policy for prompts, and legal request for encryption-at-rest proof.
Marta (Solutions Eng): On the ops side I need to know whether they will allow us to pull model artifacts into our private registry or require customer-hosted runtime. If customer-hosted, we shift to Private deployment runbook.
Aisha (AE): They prefer Redwood-hosted but require a customer-managed KMS and VPC connection.
Priya (Sales): For commercial, do we offer a short POC discount? Need a line item for variant onboarding labor (~3–5 engineer-days).
Marta (Solutions Eng): Yep estimate: 3 days compatibility validation + 2 days perf tuning + 1 day CCQ/security handoff = ~6 engineer-days. I'll draft a SOW bullet.
Connor (Infra): For perf tuning I'll want the sample prompt set and a baseline profile. If fused ops fail on our runtime we fallback to a slower kernel which will blow latency. Need to know acceptance criteria.
Aisha (AE): Acceptance = functional parity on 100 sample prompts, p99 <= 120ms on dedicated.
Marta (Solutions Eng): Action items: Aisha — get tokenizer + 2-min trace + sample prompts. Connor — prepare perf estimates for both hosted burst and 1x A100 reserved. SecurityBot — export CCQ template with our recommended answers (we'll mark anything needing legal).
Aisha (AE): On it. Tagging @Marta and @Connor — will share artifacts today.
Priya (Sales): I'll draft pricing options and include the onboarding labor line.
Marta (Solutions Eng): If artifacts arrive today I can run validator tomorrow and send a short compatibility report (tokenizer OK / opset warnings / perf risk).
Connor (Infra): Also note: if they insist on int8 fused kernels we may need a custom build — add 2–3 extra days.
Aisha (AE): Good call. I'll flag that to the customer as a potential blocker up front.
Marta (Solutions Eng): Sample config I'll try first (placeholder):
```
model: rivermoss-22b-custom
quant: int8
cache: prefix_kv
batch: dynamic
max_seq: 2048
```
Marta (Solutions Eng): I'll attach validator log to the thread when done.
SecurityBot: CCQ template: [KMS: customer-managed], [Network: VPC peering], [Data retention: 30 days configurable], [Audit logs: enabled]. Marked for legal review: data residency clause.
Aisha (AE): Thanks team — will update customer and push artifacts ASAP. :thumbsup:
Marta (Solutions Eng): :eyes: ping when logs are up.
Connor (Infra): I'll standby for perf runs once validator passes.
Priya (Sales): Will include the onboarding labor and optional custom-kernel line item in the quote.
Aisha (AE): Closing loop — ETA to customer: EOD today for tokenizer request, EOW for compatibility report.
Marta (Solutions Eng): Perfect.
